effective_text:
Introduced in the Wrath of the Righteous adventure path, the redemption mechanic allows cards with the Corrupted trait to have that trait removed, and thus used without penalty. The redemption mechanic returns for both the Hell's Vengeance Character Deck 1 and Hell's Vengeance Character Deck 2 character decks.

In any box or deck where cards can be redeemed, a Redemption checklist is provided. Players can mark off cards on this checklist when they are redeemed, providing a handy reminder for later play.

Wrath of the Righteous 
There are twenty (20) Corrupted cards in the Wrath of the Righteous adventure path, all of which appear on the path's redemption card.
